claim_ceiling: This audit classifies carrier coverage for the exact 60 admitted integrated Definitions against current candidate material. It does not materialize the 34 remaining carriers, amend Decision 0069, admit anything, create instances or relations, or activate a runtime.
classification_rule: A standalone carrier is required when an admitted Definition denotes an independently identified, attributable, versioned, lifecycle-bearing, immutable, or separately challengeable governed identity or record. An abstract class, condition, method, act/result umbrella, or explicitly ephemeral session value must instead name its exact realization and must not receive a duplicate durable identity.
decision_0069_effect: After owner approval and carrier materialization, replace the provisional 53-entry review with one definition-complete 93-entry Artifact Type admission review: six Step 7 additions plus 34 remaining Definition carriers, while preserving all pre-admission predecessors and exclusions.
